limitations: Two-robot initial 1 m tandem, R0.5, already formed. Not R0.4 pentagon adjacent0.4702m, five robots, startup assembly, curves or physical hardware.
Current bundle comparison includes native preview/budget/activation/return/geometry changes; does not isolate one component contribution.
Temporary formation deformation is allowed; endpoint recovery does not imply rigid formation throughout.
Peer gap stayed large in new runs; dense mutual-avoidance interaction has not been stressed.
Point-level truth association is offline only. Local cluster files are not sent as ROS prediction messages or consumed by other controllers.
Gazebo world-source odometry, CV near-cylinder hypothesis, no occlusion/communication-fault or real odometry-drift validation.
Legacy current-run low-speed failure does not erase old stage successes or prove its equations mathematically wrong.
No hard realtime or physical continuous mesh safety guarantee. Raw data/images/papers not uploaded; same-disk copies are not offsite backup.
